title: What Operations Teams Build With AI: Dashboards, Trackers, and Process Automators
summary: Ops teams are replacing $890/month in per-seat tools by building custom vendor trackers, compliance dashboards, and process documentation portals with AI. Here are the 6 most useful.
body_markdown:
Open[blink.new](https://blink.new/) and type exactly what you need. Be specific about columns, views, and alerts. A good starting prompt for the vendor tracker:


> "Build me a vendor management tracker with: vendor name, contract value, start date, renewal date, payment terms (net 30/60/90), status (active/expired/pending), and a contact field. Show a dashboard view of contracts expiring in the next 30 and 90 days. Include a CSV import button."


Blink generates the app with the database, auth, and interface in one shot. No Supabase account needed — the database is included automatically.
